drafter.private_reasoning: The draft leaves the settlement amount and payment timing unspecified and makes the release one-sided and potentially overbroad. Propose a clear, mutual release effective upon payment, preserve enforcement rights, and add a customary confidentiality disclosure exception. Do not disclose the client’s confidential information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We have made a few clarifying revisions to help move this toward execution, including making the release mutual and clarifying the confidentiality provision. The draft still needs the agreed settlement amount and payment deadline; please provide your proposed figures and timing so we can finalize those terms promptly.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount of [Settlement Amount] (the “Settlement Amount”) by [Payment Deadline], by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. The parties will confirm the Settlement Amount and Payment Deadline before execution.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant and its past and present affiliates, officers, directors, employees, and agents from all claims arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement, based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is executed. Effective upon that same payment, Defendant releases Plaintiff and its past and present affiliates, officers, directors, employees, and agents from all claims arising out of or relating to those same matters and based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is executed. Nothing in this Section releases a party’s rights or obligations under this Agreement or claims that cannot lawfully be released.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential and shall not disclose them to any third party, except to their respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who are informed of the confidential nature of the terms; as required by law, regulation, court order, or other compulsory legal process; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a disclosure required by law or compulsory process shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement and the payment made under it are not an admission of liability or wrongdoing by either party.
edits.name: No Admission
